rows.question: Where do I report an absence?
rows.answer:
To report a student absence at Vista Ridge High School, you have two main options:

- You can submit an absence note or medical documentation via email from the parent/guardian's email address that is on file to VRHSattendance@leanderisd.org.
- You can hand deliver the absence note or documentation to the Attendance Office.

Notes should include the student's full legal name, ID number, grade, and the reason for the absence. It's best to submit the note within two days after the student returns to school. Phone calls are not accepted for reporting absences.

For more details, you can visit the [Absence for students](https://www.leanderisd.org/attendance) page.

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!

rows.question: What is the student check-out policy?
rows.answer:
Here is the student check-out policy at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year:

- **Parent/Guardian Presence Required:** A parent or guardian must come to the office in person, provide a photo ID, and check the student out.  
- **No Phone Calls:** Phone calls for early dismissal are NOT accepted for student safety.
- **Advance Notice:** If possible, arrive at least 20 minutes before you need your student to be released, due to high volume of requests.
- **No Late Check-Outs:** In-person early check-outs after 2:45 pm will not be granted. After 2:45 pm, students must wait for regular dismissal.
- **Student Sign-In/Out:** Students MUST sign in and out at the Attendance Window when leaving or returning to campus.
- **Documentation Required:** To excuse the absence created by an early check-out, a follow-up note or email documenting the reason is required. The note/email should include the student’s full legal name, ID#, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal. Emails sent before 10:30 AM can be used for check-outs later in the day.
- **Why Documentation Matters:** Proper documentation helps prevent truancy proceedings, which can begin after 10 unexcused absences.

For full details and step-by-step instructions, see:  
[How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out)

If you have more questions, the Attendance Office is the best place to ask. Let me know if you need anything else!
sources: How To Check Your Student Out Early

rows.question: How do I appeal an attendance decision?
rows.answer:
To appeal an attendance decision at Vista Ridge High School, you need to follow the process for an attendance hours appeal. Here’s what the context says for the 2026-2027 school year:

- Appeals are only considered for extenuating circumstances (such as medical procedures or emergencies).
- You must provide supporting documentation for your situation; appeals without documentation will be denied.
- The process involves filling out a Student Attendance Appeal Request form. You can get this form by contacting your assistant principal.
- Once completed, the form (with documentation) is submitted for review by the appeals committee, which meets regularly.
- The committee will decide whether you need to make up all, some, or none of the hours owed.

**What to do:**
- Contact your [assistant principal](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhs-assistant-principals-offi/home) to discuss your situation and request the appeals form.
- Gather any documentation that supports your appeal (doctor’s notes, etc.).
- Complete the form and submit it as directed by your assistant principal.

If you have any questions or need help with the process, your assistant principal is the best person to guide you.

Let me know if you need help finding the right contact or have any other questions!

rows.question: How do I register for AP tests?
rows.answer:
Here’s how to register for AP tests at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year:

**Step 1: Register with College Board**
- Create or log in to your College Board account at [myap.collegeboard.org](https://myap.collegeboard.org/login).
- Enroll in each of your AP classes using the JOIN CODE provided by your teacher.
- Indicate whether you plan to take the AP exam (“YES” or “NO”) for each class. If you do not want to take the exam, change your status to “NO” before the October 28, 2026 deadline.
- Even if you are not taking the exam, you must still register with MyAP.

**Step 2: Register and Pay with Total Registration**
- Go to the [Total Registration Link](https://user.totalregistration.net/AP/441176).
- Create an account or log in if you already have one.
- Complete the registration and pay for your exams online.
    - Exam fee: $85 per exam
    - Reduced fee: $27 per exam (for students approved for free/reduced lunch)
    - Late fee: $40 per exam if registering between October 28, 2026 and February 18, 2027
    - $45 cancellation fee after November 14, 2026; no refunds after February 18, 2027

**Deadlines**
- Registration and payment are due by October 28, 2026 for most AP courses.
- For second semester AP Government & Macroeconomics, registration is open January 5 – February 18, 2027.

**Need Help or Want to Cancel?**
- Contact the campus Dean of Instruction, Olga Angelo-Day, for assistance with AP exam registration or cancellations.

For more details and step-by-step instructions, visit the [AP Test Registration Info](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/ap-test-registration) page or the [VR Advanced Placement Website](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/advanced-placement/home).

Good luck with your AP exams, Ranger! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask.

rows.question: What do seniors need to do before graduation?
rows.answer:
Here are the main things Vista Ridge High School seniors (Class of 2027) need to do before graduation, based on the current information:

- **Order Cap and Gown:** You must order your Cap, Gown & Tassel Unit from Herff Jones. This is required for graduation.
- **Attend the Senior Meeting:** You’ll receive order packets and more information about graduation items at this meeting.
- **Complete the FAFSA:** Filling out the FAFSA is a graduation requirement. The application opens October 1st, and the priority deadline for most Texas universities is January 15th. Check each university for their specific deadlines.
- **Clear All Obligations and Hours:** All school obligations and required hours must be cleared before you can pick up your cap and gown.
- **Participate in Graduation Practice:** Attend graduation practice and the clap out immediately following.
- **Fill Out Name Pronunciation Form:** In May, you’ll be asked to fill out a form to ensure your name is pronounced correctly at graduation.
- **Prepare for Senior Events:** Participate in events like the senior panoramic picture (March 24th during Ranger Time), prom, Senior Scramble, Senior SAIL, and the Baccalaureate.
- **Elementary Graduation Walks:** If you want to participate in the tradition of walking at your former elementary school, check the [Senior Walks Schedule](https://news.leanderisd.org/class-of-2026-senior-walks-schedule-announced/) for details.
- **Google Account Transition:** After graduation, your school Google account will switch to an alumni account (firstname.lastnameXX@alum.leanderisd.org). Download any files you want to keep, as the alumni account will only be active for one year and will have limited functionality.

For more details and updates, check the [Seniors 2027 page](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/seniors-2027) and the [Project Graduation page](https://sites.google.com/view/vistaridgeprojectgrad/home).

If you have specific questions or need help with any of these steps, your counselor or the front office can guide you. Good luck with your senior year, Ranger!

rows.question: What is Ranger Time?
rows.answer:
Ranger Time at Vista Ridge High School is a dedicated period built into the daily schedule from 9:45 to 10:15 AM. It is sometimes referred to as Minga-Flextime, and students can access the [Ranger Time Portal](https://adv.leanderisd.org/login.aspx?ReturnUrl=%2fDefault.aspx) or [Minga - Ranger Time](https://app.minga.io/flextime) to manage their activities during this time.

Ranger Time is designed to give students flexibility for various activities, such as:

- Attending club meetings (for example, Rangers Alliance and Crafting for Kindness both meet during Ranger Time)
- Participating in workshops or volunteer drives
- Networking and building friendships
- Receiving academic support or enrichment

It’s a unique part of the Vista Ridge schedule that helps students get involved, catch up, or explore new interests during the school day. If you have more specific questions about how to use Ranger Time, you can ask your counselor or the sponsor of the club or activity you’re interested in.

Let me know if you’d like more details or help finding a club or activity during Ranger Time!

rows.question: How do I access my STAAR scores?
rows.answer:
You can access your STAAR scores in two main ways:

### 1. Through the Home Access Center (HAC)
- Log into your LISD Home Access Center ([Home Access Center](https://www.leanderisd.org/homeaccess)).
- Click on the Grades icon at the top of the screen.
- On the left, next to Report Card, click on Texas Test Scores.
- Your STAAR results will appear, or you’ll be directed to the Texas Student Portal.

### 2. Through the Texas Assessment Parent Portal
- Go to [TexasAssessment.gov](https://www.texasassessment.gov).
- Click "Log In to Parent Portal."
- Enter your child’s Unique Access Code and date of birth.
    - If you don’t know the access code, click "How do I find my access code?" and enter your child’s legal first name and TSDS ID (often the student’s social security number).
- View and download your STAAR results.

### Need Help?
If you have trouble accessing your scores or have questions, you can contact:
- Principal: Keith Morgan | 📞 512-570-1810 | ✉ keith.morgan@leanderisd.org
- Campus Testing Coordinator: Linsey Cernero | 📞 512-570-1823 | ✉ linsey.cernero@leanderisd.org

You can also find step-by-step instructions in English and Spanish linked on the STAAR Results Information page.

Let me know if you need more help or specific instructions!
